title: MSCHAPv2 impossible: no cleartext or NT-hash password for this user
plain_english: The user was found, but the backend gave FreeRADIUS a password in a form that cannot be used for MSCHAPv2 (an SSHA, crypt or bcrypt hash from LDAP or SQL, or no password at all). MSCHAPv2 mathematically needs the cleartext password or its NT hash. The 'MS-CHAP2-Response is incorrect' line that usually follows is a consequence, not the cause: the password was not wrong, it was unusable. Resetting the user's password will not help.

causes.cause: The directory stores one-way hashes (SSHA, crypt, bcrypt) that cannot be turned into an NT hash.
causes.next_check: Check which password attribute the backend returned for this request. Options: store NT hashes alongside (sambaNTPassword / NT-Password), store cleartext, or move these clients to EAP-TLS or TTLS-PAP.

causes.cause: The password attribute is there but not mapped: the ldap update section does not map userPassword to Password-With-Header, or the bind identity is not allowed to read it.
causes.next_check: In mods-available/ldap check the update { } mapping; run ldapsearch as the module's identity and confirm the password attribute is returned.

causes.cause: Active Directory backend: AD never returns password hashes over LDAP, so mschap must ask the domain via ntlm_auth or winbind instead of reading a password.
causes.next_check: Set ntlm_auth (or winbind_username/winbind_domain) in mods-available/mschap and join the RADIUS host to the domain; test with ntlm_auth --request-nt-key --username=... --password=...
